configurePresets.name: windows-x86_64
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x86_64 engine tests (MinGW-w64 UCRT64 + Ninja)
configurePresets.description: Phase 2 contract preset (plans/WINDOWS_IMPL.md sections 3.2 and 5.1). Run on a pinned windows-2022 runner with the MinGW-w64 UCRT64 toolchain and Ninja on PATH. Mirrors the player's platform source selection: all Win32 platform sources have landed, so this test project configures and builds on WIN32 (and the standalone PLAYER preset's platform source selection is complete too — its WIN32 configure proceeds to the SDL3/ANGLE dependency checks); it never falls back to POSIX sources. CI runs the suite with an explicit CTest invocation rather than a test preset: ctest --test-dir build/engine-tests-windows-x86_64 --output-on-failure (path relative to the repo root, matching binaryDir), mirroring .github/workflows/linux-x64.yml
